title: Notification preference controls

behavior.accessiblePanel: The notification bell opens a preferences panel with native checkbox controls, descriptions and a back action.
behavior.tenantUserScope: The panel reads and writes the existing tenant- and user-bound preferences endpoints; no client-side organization or user identity is accepted.
behavior.explicitSave: Category changes remain local until Save preferences is selected; Cancel and back discard unsaved changes.
behavior.feedRefresh: A successful save refreshes the notification list and unread badge, so muted categories disappear from the default feed immediately.
behavior.preserved: Existing notification loading, polling, read/unread, read-all, category filtering and generation guards remain in place.

localVerification.browserRegressionLocal: Not claimed locally; the browser fixture requires the owned application services and the verifier fails closed when Redis 127.0.0.1:6379 is already occupied.

limits: This increment adds notification preference UI only; it claims no external email, push, realtime transport or SLO.
No schema or migration changes were introduced.
CI verifies owned fixtures and does not deploy.
Production/live-provider, remote durability/RPO-RTO and full-master acceptance remain open.
